hypothesis: Can a data-trained leave-one-trajectory-out complexity prior select a more transferable degree<=4 GF2 causal polynomial within the SAME original 24 eight-event labeled FIT episodes and ZERO extra source oracle labels, instead of the existing minimum-monomial degree4 interpolant? A separately implemented fully tuned cross-validation ANF peer receives identical 24 FIT labels, hypothesis class, loss and search time budget.
experiment_scope: ENGINEERING DEVELOPMENT FEASIBILITY ONLY, not independently authored scientific source birth or prospective firstuse. Developmental deterministic synthetic examples are consumed after qualification and NEVER reused as a future untouched prospective cohort.

models.candidate: For each of 10 two-nibble causal source bindings and degree cap 1..4, train on the first 20 FIT trajectories, score exactly four heldout FIT trajectories fully autoregressively; choose minimum CV error and lower polynomial complexity/wiring tie; refit all 24 FIT trajectories under chosen degree. No source/oracle function template; no extra training label.
models.strong_independent_peer: Independently source-neutral fully trained/optimized GF2 polynomial learner that performs the same CV over 10 bindings x 4 degree thresholds, fits 20 FIT episodes and tests 4 heldout FIT trajectories. Equal training/public information and full candidate selection.
models.frozen_full_degree4_reference: Previously qualified F124-DE 163-term degree4 learner (without cross-validation), same public 24 FIT and no extra query; not a weak main control.

strict_scoring: No new FIT case before original complete engineering freeze; all arms choose polynomial complexity without CHECK/HELDOUT feedback, natural CHECK all eight complete trajectories correct before 8 positive and 8 different-role matched negatives can count, zero admitted hard false positives. No non-fit/admission model credited with negative performance.
failure_conditions: If candidate does not exceed independent fully trained CV peer at equal information, do NOT claim algorithmic superiority; if CPU higher report cost regression; full rank nonidentifiability bound remains regardless of CV.
mechanism_limits: A CV-selected degree cap is a data-learned regularization prior, not an independent new source operator, learned recurrent cognition or ability to guarantee unseen responses from underdetermined FIT.
